title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course by BAI aims to enhance coaching standards for Indian badminton at key national centers.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting an advanced Level-1 coaches course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a significant domestic team championship, shaping competition for Indian states.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This change impacts Indian junior players vying for a spot in the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification has been issued regarding a change in a women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships Begins
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Indian Para-Badminton Stars Pramod and Sukant Achieve Milestones in Japan
indian_angle: This highlights significant achievements by top Indian para-badminton players on the international stage.
summary: Indian para-badminton ace Pramod Bhagat secured a gold and a silver medal, while fellow player Sukant Kadam celebrated reaching his career 100-medal milestone at a tournament in Japan.
